Neon Abyss is a story that revolves around the Titans, the gods of Olympus, humans, and the New Gods.

The existence of Titan Group and the gods as a secret driving force behind the human world is a fact not many humans are aware of. Humans who do come to know of Titan Group tend to be persecuted and eliminated.
Before the birth of humans, the world was ruled by Titans. They possessed great divine power drawn from the land itself. However, the Titans' rule began to falter with the rise of their descendants.
At the cusp of the final battle, Prometheus foresaw the impending defeat of his people with his power of foresight.
At the cusp of the final battle, Prometheus foresaw the impending defeat of his people with his power of foresight.
At the cusp of the final battle, Prometheus foresaw the impending defeat of his people with his power of foresight.
In an effort to preserve the last hope of the Titans, Prometheus chose to ally with Zeus and saved himself while the other Titans were imprisoned in the Abyss.
Since then, Prometheus quietly plotted the revival of the Titans while under Zeus' rule. With the power of his foresight, he discovered a way to weaken the gods of Olympus.
To make this future possible, he must create a new species—essential pawns to aid in the revival of the Titans—humans.
Prometheus created humans in his image but did not grant them a strong physique or eternal life. The gods of Olympus, especially Zeus, did not think to remain vigilant against such weak creatures.

The gods ensured the survival of the weak humans with the condition that the humans worship them. The number of humans began to multiply and grow, and they erected temples in honor of the gods of Olympus.
With that, the gods of Olympus rose to the pinnacle of their strength by relying on the pure faith of humans.
Realizing how easy it was to become more powerful with the faith of humans, the gods of Olympus began to forget the source of the original power: nature.

Prometheus spared no effort in aiding the humans. He showed them fire and secretly pushed for the advancement of human civilization, helping them develop from an agricultural society to an industrial one until they finally entered the information age.
The Titans were indispensable in their aid as well. As beings of the land, they provided humans with the energy necessary to revolutionize their civilization: coal, petroleum, and rare earth metals.
The faith of humans gradually changed with the shifting times, replacing the worship of gods with science.
The gradual loss of faith was weakening the strength the gods had so relied on, but they were too lost in their pursuit of lust and excess to notice.
Modern humans no longer held absolute faith in nature. Their faiths have grown more varied.
New Gods such as the God of Mobile Videos, the God of Pills, the Goddess of Makeup, the God of Fast Food, and many others emerged alongside the new faith of modern humans.
The Titans saw the birth of the New Gods and used their discontent under the rule of the gods of Olympus to their advantage. Together, they conspired to overthrow the gods.

The Third War of the Gods ended with the Titans and New Gods as victors. The Titans use the humans' faith to keep the New Gods under their thumb while using the New Gods to control the lives of humans. It's no exaggeration to say the Titan Group have control over every aspect of the human world.
The Titans replaced the current administrators of the Abyss with the New Gods. The depths of the Abyss—what was once decreed by Zeus to be the Titans' prison—is now under the management of Titans.
Many of the defeated gods of Olympus have accepted new roles given to them by Titan Group and now work for them.
As for Hades, he remains in his old position due to the help he offered the Titans in their revolt, and now manages the Cerberus Bar atop the Abyss.
However, Hades isn't content to remain an underling in Titan Group. He has gathered a group of heroes who were persecuted by the Titans and formed the Grim Squad to strike back at Titan Group.
Yet, it seems the sly Hades is hiding plans of a different nature.
